I told Marcus in a thread reply in #north-team that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June.

Ilse first said 25 November in #north-team on 14 Oct. The same morning she corrected it in #north-random, saying it's 10 June and she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is in #north-random, so quoting her correction to him in #north-team was fine. I also told him to ignore the 25 November in that earlier thread, including my own reply that repeated it.

There's no Brackenwater account file I can read, so I couldn't check the date against one; Ilse's correction is the only source. I didn't try gbrain this time because it refused my connection last time. The 25 November thread in #north-team still has no correction in it, so anyone who reads only #north-team could pick up the wrong date.
